description: This file defines API route handlers for category management in an expense tracker application, using FastAPI. It includes endpoints for creating, listing, updating, and deleting categories, integrating with a CategoryService and handling dependency injection for database sessions and user authentication.

classes.name: CategoryCreate
classes.description: Schema for creating a new category.

classes.name: CategoryUpdate
classes.description: Schema for updating an existing category.

classes.name: CategoryOut
classes.description: Schema for serializing category data returned by API.
